Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Absence of acute opportunistic infection at time of entry. However, if patient is successfully treated for opportunistic infection and has remained stable for 2 weeks after treatment, the patient is then allowed to enter the study.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has no mention of acute opportunistic infection at entry, and no evidence of recent opportunistic infection treatment.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Parent or guardian available to give written informed consent.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient or their legal representative.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Prior Medication: AMENDED: AZT or ddI up until study entry, other antiretrovirals up until 4 weeks of study entry.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's medical history does not mention prior use of AZT, ddI, or other antiretrovirals.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Children receiving maintenance therapy for > 4 weeks are eligible.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is an adult (58 years old), so this criterion does not apply.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has a documented history of ischemic cardiomyopathy confirmed by heart biopsy, which is a symptomatic condition.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Concurrent Medication: Excluded: Other antiviral agents, biological modifiers, and investigational medications.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is on metformin, which is not classified as an antiviral agent, biological modifier, or investigational medication.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Concurrent Medication: Excluded: Drugs with potential to cause peripheral neuropathy, including chloramphenicol, iodoquinol, phenytoin, ethionamide, gold, ribavirin, vincristine, cisplatin, dapsone, disulfiram, glutethimide, hydralazine, metronidazole, nitrofurantoin.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is not taking any of the excluded drugs listed (e.g., phenytoin, metronidazole, etc.).

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with the following are excluded: Acute bacterial infections requiring IV or oral antibiotic treatment at time of entry.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no mention of acute bacterial infections requiring antibiotic treatment at the time of entry.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Prior Medication: Excluded: Antiretroviral agents (other than zidovudine (AZT) or didanosine (ddI)) within 4 weeks of entry.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has no history of antiretroviral use, so this criterion is not applicable.

Recap: The patient is excluded due to symptomatic cardiomyopathy and does not meet the prior medication criterion (no AZT/ddI use). All other criteria are either met or not applicable.
